_note: DeepSeek local-test branch. THE API KEY IS NOT IN THIS FILE - paste it on Settings > API or set $DEEPSEEK_API_KEY. Never commit it.
_base_url_note: DeepSeek's Anthropic-compatible endpoint root. /v1/messages is appended by the program. Overridable on the Settings screen or with $DEEPSEEK_BASE_URL.
_model_note: deepseek-flash is required because it supports image input. PDFs are rendered locally to JPEG pages before the request; DeepSeek does not accept PDF document blocks.
_pdf_note: Requires PyMuPDF. PDF pages are rendered at pdf_dpi and sent as inline JPEG image blocks. The encoded request is capped below DeepSeek's 48 MiB request-body limit.
